items.docs:
This API returns all groups of a specific project based on its id. Without any extra parameters it will return the first 100 groups ordered by ascending ID. Extra parameters can be added to sort the results.
Group Sorting: Groups can be sorted by the amount of users they have.
Example: `/project_groups?sort=count`
